segmente.text: Everyone says, don't sell the product, sell the outcome, but almost no one shows you how.
Don't worry, I'm going to give you a simple hack that will make people feel dumb saying no to your product.
It's called the So You Can method.
You take your product or feature, add So You Can, and then finish with the outcome.
For example, a home alarm system so you can feel safe at night,
or noise-canceling headphones so you can get your work done with no distractions.
It works because you stop selling the product and start selling what your customer actually needs.
So try it on your product and drop the best one in the comments.
